evidence.detail: Sort queue loads 'NOT d.reviewed' decks with no admin check and no active-run exclusion — all demimods see full player/deck info for active league runs
@auth.demimod_required on edit_archetypes — route is accessible to non-admin sorters
exclude_active_league_runs() clause already exists and is applied for non-admin users in decks_where(), but is not applied to the sort queue deck load

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/edit_archetypes.py, import auth and check auth.is_admin() (or session.get('admin')). When not admin, pass the exclude_active_league_runs(viewer_id) clause into the deck.load_decks() call at line 14 so active league runs are excluded from the sort queue for non-admin sorters. Alternatively, mask d.person and d.name for active runs if excluding is not desired.
triage.notes: The issue comment struck through 'Also hide active runs on /people/person' noting it was already true — that's a separate code path. The sort queue itself (edit_archetypes.py) has no such protection. Product call needed on exclude vs. anonymize, but the code change is small either way.
